questions.question: PM-KISAN scheme provides direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to which category?
questions.explanation: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments to small and marginal farmers having cultivable land up to 2 hectares.

questions.question: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban), houses are provided to which income group at the highest subsidy?
questions.explanation: The Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category with income up to ₹3 lakh per annum receives the highest subsidy of 6.5% under PMAY-Urban's Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme.

questions.question: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides health coverage of how much per family per year?
questions.explanation: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana provides health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

questions.question: Which scheme was launched to provide clean cooking fuel to BPL households?
questions.explanation: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana was launched in 2016 to provide LPG connections to women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households, targeting 8 crore connections.

questions.question: The National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) is implemented by which ministry?
questions.explanation: NAPS is implemented by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship to promote apprenticeship training by sharing 25% of stipend cost with employers.

questions.question: PM Vishwakarma Yojana targets traditional artisans with collateral-free credit up to:
questions.explanation: PM Vishwakarma provides collateral-free credit support of ₹1 lakh in first tranche and ₹2 lakh in second tranche at 5% concessional interest rate to 18 traditional crafts.

questions.question: Stand-Up India scheme mandates at least one loan per bank branch to which categories?
questions.explanation: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.

questions.question: Atal Pension Yojana is regulated and administered by:
questions.explanation: Atal Pension Yojana is administered by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) and targets unorganised sector workers aged 18-40 years.

questions.question: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana aims to install rooftop solar in how many households?
questions.explanation: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana targets installation of rooftop solar panels in 1 crore households to provide up to 300 units of free electricity per month.

questions.question: Which scheme provides financial assistance for construction of individual household toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission (Rural)?
questions.explanation: Under Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin), financial assistance of ₹12,000 is provided to each BPL household for construction of individual household toilets.

questions.question: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana offers Tarun category loans up to:
questions.explanation: PM Mudra Yojana offers three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh) for non-corporate, non-farm small enterprises.

questions.question: e-SHRAM portal was launched to create a national database of which workers?
questions.explanation: e-SHRAM portal was launched by Ministry of Labour to create a comprehensive National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW), linking to Aadhaar for social security benefits.
